title: Sandbox Host: Test harness
description:
Implement test harness for SandboxHostService from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: Full test harness doc — P1-P5 (property), FI1-FI6 (fault injection), DS1-DS3 (deterministic simulation), B1-B5 (benchmarks), ST1-ST3 (stress), SEC1-SEC3 (security)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests: session lifecycle invariants, tool dispatch correctness, snapshot ordering, tier classification consistency, concurrent session isolation
- Fault injection: ZFS failure during session create, gVisor crash during tool exec, snapshot failure during TurnComplete, timeout propagation, cascading failures, partial cleanup
- Deterministic simulation: session state machine exhaustive walks, snapshot DAG correctness, concurrent session interleavings
- Benchmarks: session create/destroy throughput, tool dispatch latency by tier, snapshot create/rollback time, concurrent session scaling
- Stress tests: max concurrent sessions, rapid create/destroy cycles, snapshot accumulation
- Security tests: session isolation verification, path traversal prevention, resource limit enforcement
- Integration tests using MockManager for both ZFS and gVisor

Depends on: Sandbox Host Service core implementation task.
